subject: math
description: Calculate and estimate volumes of rectangular pyramids using V = (1/3)lwh, with attention to base area, height, context, and cubic unit labels.
learningObjectives: Identify the length, width, and perpendicular height needed for a rectangular pyramid volume calculation
Use V = (1/3)lwh to calculate the volume of rectangular pyramids
Estimate rectangular pyramid volumes by rounding dimensions before computing
Write volume answers with appropriate cubic units and interpret them in context
prerequisites: Find the area of a rectangle using length times width
Recognize that volume is measured in cubic units
